question: Roll the paper: straight lines stay straight

scene.title: Roll the paper: straight lines stay straight
scene.subtitle: Earlier version, built on the same bent map. The bent map of height and time, rolled into a paper cone. The ball’s path is still the straightest line on it.
scene.takeaway: Spacetime can be curved while falling things still go as straight as they can through it.

beats.title: A flat map
beats.body: Here is a map of height and time. Without gravity it stays flat, and staying put is the straight path.

beats.title: Roll it up
beats.body: With gravity, the map is bent so the ball’s path is straight. Now roll the paper into a cone. Nothing stretches, so the ball’s path is still the straightest line on the paper.

beats.title: Curved, but straight
beats.body: On the cone the paths look curved from outside. On the paper itself, the ball still goes as straight as it can. That is what falling is.
